title: The Day and Its Times
label: ch:gu-day-and-its-times
canDo: I can hear and say eight everyday Gujarati time words, and read and write two of them.

payoff.summary: Four parts of a day, the day, the month, today, and now enter meaning-first by ear; two of them reach the page with signs taught long before, the chapter closes on four separately scored skills, and one short return re-scores all eight a lesson later.
